watch.title: Appeal against the EU–US Data Privacy Framework adequacy decision is pending
watch.status: Pending before the Court of Justice; no hearing date found as of 2026-10-03
watch.summary: The General Court dismissed an action for annulment of the adequacy decision on 3 September 2025 (Case T-553/23, Latombe v Commission). The applicant appealed to the Court of Justice on 31 October 2025 (Case C-703/25 P). If the appeal succeeds, transfers that rely on the framework would need another mechanism, such as standard contractual clauses.
